crate.name: comsol-mcp-shim
crate.version_policy: Tracks comsol_mcp.__version__; dev trees carry a -dev pre-release. The release batch bumps both in one commit.
crate.msrv_theoretical_note: Edition 2024 first shipped with Rust 1.85, so 1.85 is the theoretical lower bound. No build on an older toolchain is tested or claimed; the shim ships as prebuilt binaries.

windows.reason: The build host has no MSVC Build Tools; the GNU toolchain is self-contained. An MSVC lane needs its own reviewed build and acceptance before any release claims it.

linux.reason: Built and verified on Ubuntu 26.04 (WSL2, native ext4 filesystem). No licensed-COMSOL-on-Linux claim is made or implied.

distribution.wheel: Unchanged. The Python wheel stays py3-none-any and never contains a shim binary.
distribution.artifacts: Shim binaries are separately hashed optional artifacts. No auto-download, no silent client changes; a client opts in with an explicit launch command.
distribution.verification: Every published binary carries a SHA-256 recorded beside it; consumers verify before use. Reference build manifest: D:/mcp_tests/p0082/p05/shim-build-manifest.json.

dependency_licenses.policy: Every runtime and build-time crate in the committed Cargo.lock is MIT, MIT OR Apache-2.0, or an equivalent permissive grant (MIT-0, Unicode-3.0). No copyleft dependency exists in the graph. Licenses were read from the crate manifests in the local cargo registry source cache, not from memory.

graph.zmij 1.0.23: MIT (verified from the registry source cache)
graph.memchr 2.8.3: MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR (UNLICENSE OR MIT)

release_profile.note: panic=abort makes any internal panic close the transport immediately; the crash path exits explicitly with code 3.
